title: UK DRCF AI Audit Framework -- Summer 2026 Update and Enforcement Roadmap
context: 2026-08-26 -- DRCF (Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum: ICO, Ofcom, CMA, FCA) published its Summer 2026 AI audit framework refresh
body: The UK Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum (DRCF) published its Summer 2026 AI audit framework refresh on 14 August 2026, consolidating cross-regulator expectations for AI system audits across data protection (ICO), online safety (Ofcom), competition (CMA), and financial services (FCA). The framework introduces a unified pre-audit questionnaire that maps to 42 control objectives spanning all four regulator remits. For AI system operators, this creates a single-audit-multiple-regulator pathway: pass one DRCF-aligned audit and produce evidence admissible across all four regulators. The Council of AI measurement board maps directly into the DRCF framework: 14 axes produce 22 observation types, each keyed to at least one DRCF control objective. DEFONEOS-SEAL credentials serve as pre-audit evidence of compliance posture. Key dates: DRCF pilot audit window opens October 2026 for financial services AI (FCA-led) and online platform recommendation systems (Ofcom-led). The ICO enforcement track for high-risk AI processing begins January 2027 under the UK Data Protection and Digital Information Bill (Royal Assent expected Q3 2026).
